segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I had us down for 55 analyst seats, 8 admin seats, and a May 6 go-live for the new division. Is that still the shape of it?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly, yeah. We’re at 54 analysts now. One person moved teams yesterday, so I don’t want to buy a seat we won’t use.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. So 54 analyst seats at $72 per seat per month, 8 admins included in the platform fee, and the annual platform fee is $18,600. That puts the 12-month total at $65,256 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And invoicing, can you split it 50% in April and 50% in October? Finance asked me to confirm that before I say yes.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that payment schedule is supported. First invoice would issue April 15 for $32,628, net 30. Second invoice October 15 for the same amount, also net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. The other thing is the contract language. We need the same auto-renew clause removed like last year. Just a fixed term, April 15, 2026 through April 14, 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, fixed 12-month term, no auto-renew. I’ll send the order form with that language. The master terms stay the same as your current agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. On go-live, if we sign by Friday, are we still good for May 6? We’ve got training blocks already on the calendar.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If signature is in by April 12, kickoff is April 18, admin training April 25, and end-user training May 2 and May 3. That supports May 6 without rushing it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, send it over to me and Marcus in procurement. If the numbers match what you just said, we should be able to turn it around this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form today with the 54 seats, split billing, fixed term, and the May 6 launch dates called out.
